legal.termsContent:
Welcome to Ciudad Friki.

1. Acceptance of Terms
By downloading and using this application, you agree to comply with these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

2. Use of the Application
The app is designed for the geek/friki community. You agree to use it respectfully and legally.

3. Frikicoins (Virtual Currency)
Frikicoins are digital loyalty points with no real monetary value outside the Ciudad Friki ecosystem. They are not redeemable for cash.

4. User Account
You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and password. Ciudad Friki is not responsible for unauthorized access.

5. Intellectual Property
All app content (logos, designs, texts) is property of Corporación Ciudad Friki. You may not reproduce it without authorization.

6. Limitation of Liability
Ciudad Friki is not responsible for:
• Loss of Frikicoins due to account misuse
• Service interruptions
• Content generated by other users

7. Termination
We reserve the right to suspend or delete accounts that violate these terms.

8. Governing Law
These terms are governed by the laws of Colombia.

9. Modifications
We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Updates will be notified in the app.

10. Contact
For inquiries about these terms:
Email: udcarkangel@gmail.com
Corporación Ciudad Friki - NIT 901.597.939-0
legal.privacyContent:
At Ciudad Friki, we value your privacy.

1. Data Collection
We collect basic information (name, email, location) to improve your experience and offer personalized rewards.

2. Information Usage
We use your data to manage your account, process Frikicoin transactions, and send relevant notifications.

3. Sharing with Third Parties
IMPORTANT: By accepting this policy, you authorize Corporación Ciudad Friki to share your data (such as interests and general location) with strategic partners and sponsors to offer exclusive benefits, events, and promotions. We will never sell your data to spammers.

4. Security
We implement standard security measures to protect your information.

5. User Rights
You have the right to:
• Access your personal data
• Request correction of incorrect information
• Request deletion of your account and data
• Revoke consent at any time

To exercise these rights, contact us at: udcarkangel@gmail.com

6. Data Retention
We retain your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, your data will be removed within 30 days.

7. Google Authentication
When you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email, and profile picture. We do not store your Google password. You can revoke access from your Google account at any time.

8. Changes to this Policy
We reserve the right to update this policy. We will notify you of important changes through the app.

9. Contact
For questions about this policy:
Email: udcarkangel@gmail.com
Corporación Ciudad Friki - NIT 901.597.939-0
legal.frikicoinsContent:
Frikicoins are the official currency of Ciudad Friki.

🪙 What are they for?
They are used to redeem rewards, access exclusive events, get discounts at partner stores, and participate in giveaways.

🚀 How to earn them?
You can earn Frikicoins by attending events, completing missions in the app, inviting friends, or buying from sponsor stores.

Collect and dominate Ciudad Friki!
legal.ecoContent:
🌍 Our Commitment to the Planet

For 10 years, Frikicoins were physical coins printed on paper and plastic. Although collectible, they generated a significant environmental impact.

🌱 The Digital Evolution
We have digitized our economy to reduce our carbon footprint. By eliminating physical printing:
- We save paper and water.
- We reduce plastic waste.
- We decrease emissions from transport and logistics.

Thank you for being part of this change. Now your wallet is digital and eco-friendly!
legal.corporationContent:
How is the geek community composed?
The geek community is composed of a wide sociocultural diversity of groups and people who integrate around a common hobby or an activity they practice together. The numerous subgroups of geeks are constituted by individuals with common characteristics among themselves who build brotherhood and group identities, in addition to sharing their knowledge in various specific fields, or participating together in activities that contribute to dynamizing their knowledge and appropriation of the environment.

How is the geek community organized?
In 2011, a group of young people and adults with diverse hobbies and artistic expressions decided to articulate efforts to create a space that promoted multiple cultural, recreational, and artistic manifestations. As a result of this process, the Underground Community Youth Cultural Network was born in the city of Medellín, an articulation platform formed by youth, cultural, recreational, sports, and artistic groups, representing and promoting new forms of citizen expression.
This Network has structured a sociocultural organization model in the municipality of Medellín, based on legal frameworks that protect and promote the formation and development of youth cultural processes and expressions. Its approach integrates creative, solidarity, and popular economies, especially regarding alternative and digital cultures, recognizing them as dynamizers of youth, participatory, sociocultural, political, artistic, and commercial processes.

What is the objective of this organization?
The main objective of the organization is to facilitate the development, commercialization, exchange, and dissemination of cultural, artistic, recreational, technological, and training goods and services. This includes the offer, exchange, distribution, rental, purchase, research, and development of products and projects, as well as the hiring of artists and specialized personnel in these fields.
Through the promotion of collective creative exercise, it seeks to strengthen the development of geek culture in its multiple manifestations, with special emphasis on the participation of childhood, adolescence, and youth. From its own language, symbols, and social dynamics, the organization promotes research, training, production, and distribution of diverse cultural, environmental, educational, recreational, sports, technological, and community expressions.
This interdisciplinary and intercultural approach allows the generation of spaces for creation and exchange, based on principles of cooperation, freedom of expression, and open-mindedness. Consequently, favorable conditions are created for the dignification of cultural work, the strengthening of support networks, the promotion of creative employment, and the production of innovative goods with high social and commercial value.

What is Corporación Ciudad Friki?
As a result of the organizational process of the Underground Community Youth Cultural Network, the legal formalization and corporate development of Corporación Ciudad Friki was achieved, registered with NIT 901.597.939-0. This entity was consolidated as the legal entity responsible and coordinating the Network, guaranteeing the sustainability and growth of its activities.
During more than 14 years of trajectory, Corporación Ciudad Friki has been recognized in the District of Medellín as a youth, cultural, social, recreational, sports, and citizen associative process. It has had the support and recognition of various institutions and entities, including the Ministry of Culture, the Ministry of Citizen Participation, the Ministry of Youth, Ruta N, the Pedro Nel Gómez House Museum, the Moravia Cultural Development Center, the EPM Foundation, the Local Administrative Board of Commune 4, ASOCOVIC IV, INDER, Parque Explora, Comfenalco, Comfama, and the Local Planning and Participatory Budget Program of the District of Medellín. These entities have contributed in various ways to the strengthening and consolidation of the geek community in the region.
legal.fiestaFrikiContent:
What does friki mean?
The term "friki" is an adaptation of the English "freaky" and is used to describe people whose interests and tastes are often classified as unusual, extravagant or out of the ordinary. In Spanish-speaking countries, it is also used with the meaning of "fanatic" in certain contexts.
Colloquially, the term "friki" refers to those people who present unconventional behaviors or lifestyles and who enjoy hobbies that require imagination, creativity and artistic expression. Within these activities are role-playing games, animation, comics, manga, modeling, origami, board games, theater, dance, music and some alternative sports, among others.

Fiesta Friki:
Fiesta Friki is one of the most emblematic events of geek and alternative culture in our country, with a trajectory that exceeds fourteen years of uninterrupted realization, this celebration has been consolidated as a platform for massive, creative and diverse encounters, annually bringing together thousands of people around emerging cultural practices, independent artistic expressions and collective experiences that reflect the dynamism of the geek, otaku and alternative communities of the region.

This free and open access event transforms public space for four consecutive days, proposing a cultural ecosystem that articulates entertainment, art, training and geek entrepreneurship.

Fiesta Friki thus becomes an event where cosplay scenarios, dance, concerts, workshops, entrepreneurship fairs, video game tournaments, role-playing games, genre literature, performance, illustration and multiple disciplines that configure the contemporary nerdy universe converge.

Every year, it invites to explore the symbolic, aesthetic and emotional relationship that geek communities have built with real, fantastic or anthropomorphized animals. From pokémon to nekomimi, from the guardian animals of science fiction to the mythical creatures of epic fantasy, this thematically oriented edition proposes an affective reading of the geek world, addressing topics such as animal protection, the human-animal bond in pop narratives, and the visual representation of creatures in manga, comics, cinema, music and video games.

The event maintains its already characteristic carousel-type format, in which attendees can move between exhibition, creation, training, socialization and competition zones, in an immersive and continuous experience, this format allows participation in drawing contests, cosplay parades (including categories for cosplayers with pets), academic sessions, recreational activities for children, audiovisual projections, musical shows, k-pop and spaces for the circulation of creative products from geek entrepreneurs.

Through articulation with social networks, digital platforms and community media, Fiesta Friki also amplifies its reach through live broadcasts, interviews, narrative capsules and coverage of tournaments and awards, this digital strategy guarantees the participation of audiences that cannot attend in person, generating a hybrid dimension that strengthens the appropriation and permanence of the event in the collective imagination.

Far from being just an entertainment showcase, Fiesta Friki acts as a node for visibility and circulation of knowledge, affections, talents and ways of life that have traditionally been marginalized or made invisible within the dominant cultural spectrum, at the same time, it serves as a celebration of the continuous work of an organizational fabric committed to the integral development of its members, community building and the consolidation of an alternative, solidarity and sustainable cultural economy.

Fiesta Friki is not just an event, but a vital experience, a contemporary ritual and a shared celebration of the possible worlds dreamed by girls, boys, adolescents, young people and adults who find in geek culture a space for expression, belonging and transformation.
